text:
sara-marketing: Drafting benchmark narrative for the launch — we need a concise latency vs cost story + webinar hook. Asks: 1) chart options (heatmap / scatter / 2-panel), 2) two headline variants, 3) inbound routing rules for leads, 4) CTA copy. Goal: show unit economics and SLA-sensitive routing. Pinging design & analytics. Thoughts?

devon-growth: Heatmap is my +1. Also want a tiny 'tokens → $' microcalc next to charts. Can we map p95 latency bands to $/k tokens? :money_with_wings:

raj-product: Keep it concrete — present two canonical workloads: chat (low-latency) and batch embeddings (cost-optimized). Recommend a 2-panel with same x-axis (tokens) so people can compare.

lia-design: I can mock 3 visual options tomorrow morning. Draft headlines: top-left "Speed that scales, cost that shrinks" (option A) and alt "Performance you can predict" (option B). Palette idea: teal for latency, amber for cost.

ana-analytics: I can author the heatmap. Proposal: x=sequence length, y=requests/sec, color=avg $/1k tokens, overlay contours for p50/p95 latency. Sample query I’ll run:
```sql
SELECT seq_length, req_rate, tokens_cost_per_k, p95_latency_ms
FROM bench_run_2026
WHERE model_variant IN ('redwood-v2','open-quant')
LIMIT 10000;
```
Will produce CSVs for chat-like and batch-like slices.

tom-sales: Routing for inbound leads: form fields we need → monthly requests, avg seq len, org size, security requirements. Rule-of-thumb: leads with >500 seats or projected >$50k ARR go to AE. CTA options: "See pricing & SLA" and "Book a capacity review".

devon-growth: Webinar idea: "Serving LLMs at Scale: Costs, Latency & Tradeoffs" Panelists: Raj + Ana + 2 customers. Run format: 20m talk (3 slides), 20m demo, 20m Q&A. Short landing form to capture routing fields.

sara-marketing: Draft headline A/B for the landing page: A) "Cut inference costs without sacrificing latency" B) "Predictable LLM performance at every scale" — thoughts on which to use for paid vs organic?

lia-design: A is more action-oriented (use for growth/paid). B is trust-focused (enterprise/email/AE outreach). Use A in hero; B in retargeting creative.

ana-analytics: Inbound scoring: add weights for monthly requests (0.4), avg seq len (0.1), org size (0.3), security/regulatory flag (0.2). Map scores -> route: 0-0.3 self-serve, 0.31-0.6 demo SDR, 0.61-1 AE. I'll output the exact scoring script.

mkt-bot: Reminder: calendar slot 2026-05-12 10:00 PT available. Register URL draft: https://redwood.ai/webinar-latency-econ :calendar:

sara-marketing: Great. I'll stitch a one-pager + slide outline. Who can review the copy by EOD tomorrow? @lia-design @ana-analytics @raj-product

raj-product: I'll review the technical copy and add a small section on fallbacks and model variants + guidance on quantization tradeoffs. Keep technical notes as footers.

tom-sales: I'll prepare a 30s post-webinar follow-up script + an enterprise call play that asks about throughput, latency SLOs, and deployment mode.

devon-growth: Chart checklist to test in A/B: 1) Heatmap (cost color, latency contours), 2) 2-panel (latency vs tokens | cost vs tokens), 3) Waterfall cost breakdown per 1M tokens (GPU cycles, memory, infra). I’ll mock data and tune color ramps.

sara-marketing: Final ask: Ana, can you drop two sample CSVs (chat-like and batch-like) into #assets by noon so Lia can start visuals? I’ll assemble copy+deck after that.

ana-analytics: Will do. Expect files + brief readme with column defs (seq_length, req_rate, tokens_per_req, cost_per_k, p50_ms, p95_ms) up by 12:00 PT.

lia-design: Once CSVs are in, I’ll iterate on hero + three-chart options and post mocks here for quick feedback.

sara-marketing: Thanks everyone — moving to action. Will post the one-pager draft in this thread when ready. :rocket:
